$comment: Published search spaces for the tuned column (METHOD §8). Every provider has exactly method.tuning.maxCandidates candidates, chosen by one rule from options its registry spec documents: (1) depth values the spec maps, other than the default; (2) the provider's own options that change ranking or the excerpt text the scorer reads; (3) a region hint, country US (with the paired location option where the provider's docs ask for both); the first ones in that order fill the slots. Every other documented option is listed under `excluded` (or `normalizedExcluded`) with its reason. Candidates whose SDK cost bound is above method.tuning.maxCostPerCallUsd are dropped before any call. The split is drawn by seed from its own files and must share no item id, query, Wikidata statement or subject with the scored sets.
name: tuning

normalizedExcluded.includeDomains: a per-query filter: a fixed list would need to know the items
normalizedExcluded.excludeDomains: a per-query filter: a fixed list would need to know the items
normalizedExcluded.recency: a date filter: drops the older pages most answers are on
normalizedExcluded.startDate: a date filter: drops the older pages most answers are on
normalizedExcluded.language: a result-language filter: the nonen class asks in French, German, Spanish and Japanese, so one fixed language removes their answers

excluded.country: region comes third in the order; the two slots are filled by depth
excluded.type: the same request field as depth (the SDK maps depth to type); other values such as deep-lite have no modelled price
excluded.category: restricts results to one vertical (company, news, people...): a filter
excluded.contents: extra content types have no modelled price, and the spec's excerpts are locked to highlights
excluded.userIdentifier: an account label; no effect on results

excluded.highlightsOptions: adds 1 credit per 10 results, which the registry's costOptions does not model (the SDK bound would under-reserve), and the spec reads description, not highlights
excluded.markdownOptions: shapes the page text used for highlights, which the spec does not read
excluded.timeoutOpts: server-side timeouts; the method fixes the deadline
excluded.zdr: data retention; no effect on results
excluded.policies: account policies; no effect on ranking
excluded.tags: request labels; no effect on results

excluded.categories: restricts results to a vertical (developer, gov, research, pdf), and its price is unknown (costOptions)
excluded.ignoreInvalidURLs: error handling for invalid URLs; no documented effect on ranking
excluded.scrapeOptions: scrapes every result at an unknown price (costOptions)
excluded.timeout: a server-side timeout; the method fixes the deadline

providerOptions.purpose: Find a web page that states the factual answer to this question.

excluded.domain_type: web is the default; news and research_paper restrict results to one vertical
excluded.page: pagination: returns a later page of results

excluded.offset: pagination: returns a later page of results
excluded.ui_lang: the interface language of the response; no documented effect on ranking
excluded.goggles: custom re-ranking needs a hosted goggle file; no neutral value is documented
excluded.units: measurement units in the response; no effect on ranking

excluded.snapshot_as_of: pins an index snapshot date: a date filter
excluded.display_server_time: adds a field the spec does not read

excluded.country: region comes third in the order; the two slots are filled by depth
excluded.topic: general is the default; news and finance restrict results to one vertical
excluded.chunks_per_source: an excerpt option, second in the order; the two slots are filled by depth
excluded.include_answer: adds a generated answer outside the result list, which the method does not score
excluded.include_raw_content: adds full page text the spec does not read
excluded.include_images: adds fields the spec does not read
excluded.include_image_descriptions: adds fields the spec does not read
excluded.include_favicon: adds a field the spec does not read
excluded.include_domains_mode: applies only with includeDomains, which is excluded
excluded.exact_match: changes the query's meaning to an exact-phrase filter
excluded.auto_parameters: lets the provider pick options, at an unknown price (costOptions)
